How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find the cream easy to apply and appreciate its smooth, non-greasy texture and lightweight feel. The effectiveness and value for money receive mixed reviews, with some saying it's better than high-end creams while others find it not worth the price. The fragrance-free aspect also gets mixed feedback, with some noting it doesn't have any scent while others report possible fragrance allergy issues. Skin irritation experiences are mixed, with some customers reporting no reactions while others experienced breakouts.

About this Item

Product Description

Amazon Basics Firming Cream contains Hyaluronic Acid as a key ingredient for improving skin's natural moisture for better looking skin. Moisture rich for lasting hydration, this firming cream is also formulated without fragrance.
